summary: Add Money feature tested successfully. Backend POST /api/deposits endpoint creates deposits, updates balances, creates transactions and notifications. Frontend /add-money screen with account selector, quick amount buttons (£50, £100, £250, £500), source selector (Bank Transfer, Card Deposit, Quick Top-up), and success screen all working correctly. Home screen 'Add Money' quick action navigates properly.
action_items: No issues found - feature fully functional
All frontend UI elements working correctly
critical_code_review_comments: ✅ Backend: POST /api/deposits validates amount > 0 (returns 400 for zero/negative)
✅ Backend: POST /api/deposits validates account_id exists (returns 404 for invalid)
✅ Backend: Deposit credits account balance using $inc (atomic operation)
✅ Backend: Transaction created with type='deposit' and to_account_id set
✅ Backend: Notification created with correct amount and account type
✅ Backend: Source labels mapped correctly (bank_transfer, card_deposit, quick_topup)
✅ Backend: Returns new_balance and transaction_id in response
✅ Frontend: add-money.tsx uses useCustomization for dynamic theming
✅ Frontend: All interactive elements have testID attributes
✅ Frontend: Account selector shows Current and Savings accounts
✅ Frontend: Quick amount buttons (£50, £100, £250, £500) fill amount field
✅ Frontend: Source selector with 3 options (Bank Transfer, Card Deposit, Quick Top-up)
✅ Frontend: Success screen shows amount, new balance, Done and Add More buttons
✅ Frontend: Home screen quick action button navigates to /add-money
✅ Frontend: KeyboardAvoidingView used for mobile keyboard handling
✅ Frontend: depositsApi.addMoney() in api.ts correctly calls POST /api/deposits
context_for_next_testing_agent: Add Money feature fully tested and working. Backend validates amounts, updates balances atomically, creates transactions and notifications. Frontend has complete UI with account selector, quick amounts, source selector, and success screen. All navigation flows work correctly. No issues found.
